label: Gesture adapter (MediaPipe gesture recognizer from the teammate's module)
declared: 2026-10-15, before any gesture run or evaluation. Crop values chosen from geometry (see why), not from results. Any later change must be disclosed in the README.

source.author: anisha274
source.licence: MIT, as stated in the module's README (the repository has no LICENSE file at this commit)

mapping.source: gesture_heuristics.py at commit 180e2796, result_callback: Open_Palm / Closed_Fist -> STOP; Pointing_Up / Victory / Thumb_Up -> MOVE; any other category -> 'GESTURE: <name>' (no command); no hand -> 'SEARCHING...' (no command). Only the top category of each hand is used, as in her code.

recognizer.note: The two values are MediaPipe's internal hand-detector settings, copied unchanged from gesture_heuristics.py; they decide whether a hand is found, not whether a gesture is accepted. No gesture-score threshold is set (MediaPipe's canned classifier score_threshold stays None). The decision threshold gesture_min_confidence lives only in decision.json. Her code uses LIVE_STREAM on mirrored webcam frames; the adapter uses IMAGE mode on unmirrored robot frames.

full_frame.description: Her original approach (baseline): the whole frame goes to the recognizer. A hand is assigned to the person box containing its wrist landmark; none or several -> track_id null.

person_crop.description: One recognizer call per tracked person: the upper part of the person box, with a margin, resized so its longer side is resize_long_side_px (aspect ratio kept). The hand gets that person's track_id.

events.rule: to_gesture_events() turns one frame's detections into one GestureEvent per track_id (null included): STOP if any detection of that track is STOP, else MOVE if any is MOVE, else NONE; confidence = the highest raw score among the detections of the chosen gesture (0.0 when no hand). Raw scores are passed on unfiltered.
events.why: Several hands of one person (person_crop, num_hands 2) or several unassigned hands (track_id null) share one track key in the decision's gesture filter, which keeps only the latest event per track. Preferring STOP keeps the safe direction.

why.full_frame.num_hands: 1, as in her code: the baseline is her approach unchanged.
why.person_crop.num_hands: 2: a crop holds one person, who may gesture with either hand.
why.upper_fraction: Command gestures (raised palm, fist, pointing up, thumb up, victory) are shown between hip and above the head. In a standing person's box the hip is near 0.5 of the height from the top; 0.6 keeps the hands of a lowered arm and drops the legs.
why.margin_fraction_of_box_height: 0.1 of the person's height (about 17 cm for 1.7 m) on every side, so a hand at the edge of a loose or clipped detection box is not cut off. Box height is used because it scales with distance; box width changes with pose.
why.resize_long_side_px: At 5 m a 1.7 m person is about 160 px tall in a 530 px THUD frame (fy 459), so the crop is about 130 px and a hand about 16 px. The full frame is shrunk to the palm detector's input (192 px), which leaves the hand about 4 px; the crop is enlarged instead. 256 px is above the detector input, so the crop is never shrunk below it.

smoke.note: Sample images are git-ignored. Person boxes for person_crop come from the Stage 2 detector (weights and detector confidence from the tracking config), one image at a time, no tracking: track_id = det<k>. A smoke test, not an evaluation.

evaluation.status_note: not_evaluated until Unity recordings with ground-truth gesture labels exist.
evaluation.labels_format: CSV with columns frame_id, track_id, gesture_true (STOP / MOVE / NONE), distance_m: one row per person and frame, written by the Unity scene. Read only by gesture_eval.py.
evaluation.predictions_format: detections.jsonl of an adapter run (GestureDetection records with frame_id), both modes.
evaluation.note: Accuracy is reported per mode and distance bin, raw (no threshold) and at decision.json gesture_min_confidence (below it -> NONE, as the decision does). Coverage = labelled persons whose track received a hand detection in that mode.
